title: AI Inside the Enterprise

reader_summary.overview: So the board goes to the CEO, what does the board say? Oh, OK, I'll get like a consultant to do more AI. And then they have some centralized project that nobody knows how it works. They haven't aligned their operations, and those things will fail.

thesis: The podcast argues that enterprise AI initiatives often fail because boards demand AI adoption while CEOs rely on centralized consultant projects that lack operational alignment. This approach ignores the massive legacy complexity of large organizations, creating a significant gap between the rapid adoption of agents in Silicon Valley and the slower, more difficult integration required in established enterprises.
